# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- All editable input fields must comply with requirements from Promt.md, including robust keyboard copy/paste behavior. Editable input fields must always support paste/copy via clipboard and keyboard shortcuts regardless of active keyboard language; this is mandatory for entering Telegram API keys.
- For Telegram bulk chat clearing, add a configurable delay between deletions (0.2 to 1.5 seconds) and keep it in .env-based settings.
